authorship: independent source review; no implementation edits

evidence: The deployed producer's UsageLimitReachedError has HTTP 402 and a flat error=guest_ai_allowance_used envelope for guests; its API exception handler emits that envelope. A preparation refusal may also reach the HTTP boundary; a later refusal emits an NDJSON error_type.

The client now recognizes only exact guest_ai_allowance_used at HTTP 402 or 403. streamFetch emits fixed safe signup copy and a typed code. Offscreen forwards that code; use-chat-stream passes it to presentChatStreamError, which clears streamInterruption. ChatView renders Retry only when streamInterruption exists.

Fresh reviewer run: pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 tests/unit/api-stream.test.ts tests/unit/chat-stream-error.test.ts passed 2 files and 18 tests. The new tests exercise real streamFetch plus the real chat presenter with a substituted network response, including unrelated 402 and both NDJSON code forms. Existing tests cover unrelated 403 and response detail privacy.
The observed Store 0.2.176 HTTP 402 body bytes were not captured. No new installed artifact was exercised in this review; source acceptance does not establish the published binary's behavior.
verdict_a_acceptance.remaining_acceptance: Install an accepted current build, trigger the live guest HTTP 402 refusal, and verify the specific free-account remedy appears without Retry.

evidence: The production diff changes only the HTTP status predicate in the existing classifier; it adds no second implementation, legacy path, quota policy, or server behavior.

The new 402 case was reported red before the predicate change and green after it. Different expected outcomes for allowance and unrelated 402 make a constant-result shortcut fail; the tests assert rendered message and retry state rather than only classifier output.

Response bodies are parsed for known code but never forwarded as UI text. The fixed user-safe message is preserved, while unrelated 402 remains generic and retryable and unrelated 403 retains its old behavior.
verdict_b_quality.limit: The network substitute and direct presenter callback do not execute the offscreen broadcast or native UI. Their wiring was independently inspected in source, and installed acceptance remains a separate gate.
